decisions.reason: This low-cost burner component supports the core radiant-heater business, and nothing points to withdrawal, so it stays.
As a publicly showcased flagship line of the firm's electrification direction with sunk development investment, management will persist even if uptake is slow.
The halogen heater is less central than the other electric lines, but it still extends the infrared range and weak results can be attributed to market ramp-up, so management keeps it for now.
This multi-model industrial hall heater line is close to the core business and fits the electrification push, so commitment remains strong.
The hydrogen-capable series was publicly launched in real operation and anchors the announced low-carbon strategy, so management treats slow hydrogen adoption as temporary and persists.
